payload.rationale: ResNet18 at hidden=32 already reached 99.08% (best_epoch=6), the best result so far. This candidate modestly increases base channel width to 48 (still well within the 28x28 / 90k-sample regime) to capture slightly richer multi-scale tissue features (nuclei, cytoplasm, stroma). Key changes from the prior best: (1) class_weighting=true addresses the 1.63:1 imbalance that was unaddressed in all prior runs, potentially recovering 0.3-0.8% on minority classes (classes 5 and 7 with ~7900-8000 samples vs 12885 for class 8). (2) lr raised from 0.0005 to 0.001 for faster convergence within the cosine schedule, matching the residual_cnn's successful LR. (3) weight_decay increased from 0.0001 to 0.001 for mild L2 regularization on the wider channels. (4) label_smoothing raised to 0.1 to prevent overconfident predictions on the 9-class problem. (5) Augmentations expanded to hflip+rotate180+brightness for more geometric and photometric diversity without distorting the H&E channel asymmetry (green std 0.177 vs red/blue ~0.124). (6) Depth is set to 3 but is ignored by ResNet18's fixed two-residual-blocks-per-stage topology; hidden=48 is the sole capacity knob. Note: ResNet18's CIFAR-style 3x3 stride-1 stem preserves 28x28 spatial resolution through the first stage, which is critical for sub-pixel nuclear morphology.
